product_metadata.title: ADRIMER Ice Packs for Lunch Bags, Reusable Ice Packs for Coolers, Long-Lasting Freezer Packs for Lunch Box Ultra-Thin for Everyday Use
features: LONG-LASTING & STRONG COOLING: ADRIMER ice packs for coolers are colder than ice at 18° F (-8° C), can keep your favorite sandwiches and drinks cold up to 24 hrs without facing the messes of melted ice, great for freezer-to-lunch bags trips or any outdoor activities, such as picnics, fishing, camping

SAFE & NON-TOXIC: These freezer packs are made of 100% BPA free food-grade materials, filled with non-toxic materials, durable, portable and easy to clean, can be used immediately and quickly transfer energy, best choice for your family to picnics

REUSABLE ICE PACKS for COOLER: These cooler ice packs are lightweight and reusable, great ice alternative, save your money on pounds of ice cubes. Just add water to change the dry mixture to gel, then put the lunch box ice packs to the freezer for one night and they will be ready for use

EASY to USE: Each ice pack measures 9.8 x 9.8 x 1.0 inches, fits perfectly in cooler or lunch bags. Just add the appropriate water (28OZ water) with collapsible funnel, shake, screw cap, freeze until use. It is recommended to freeze for 24 hrs first time for the best effect , then 8-24 hrs is ok

MULTI-FUNCTIONAL ICE PACK: Perfectly pack lunch or use in large insulated coolers and totes, great for freezer-to-lunch bag trips or fits perfectly in ADRIMER Cooler Backpack as well as all types of lunch bags, box, coolers, breastmilk bags, or grocery totes. Ideal companion for your family every day use
